name: get_quote
description: Return a live Wolt checkout price for an existing restaurant basket. This creates a checkout quote but buys nothing and does not charge a card. A basket must already have been built with update_basket.

slug.description: Restaurant slug for the existing basket, as returned by search_restaurants.

delivery_target_id.description: Optional saved delivery address ID from list_delivery_addresses. If omitted, the first saved address is used and shown in the result.

courier_tip.description: Optional non-negative courier tip in cents. Defaults to 0.
